evidence.quote: Examples of merchants* that accept the Card and where you can earn additional rewards include:

eligible grocery stores and wholesale clubs, supermarkets, meat and seafood stores, candy, nut or confection stores, dairy stores, and bakeries.
This category includes purchases for grocery pickup and delivery that are placed online with grocery stores, specialty food stores or delivery service merchants
Grocery Store purchases include those made at supermarkets, meat lockers, bakeries, smaller grocery stores, and grocery delivery services.
